title: Baton Rouge Officer Shoots Gunman Who Fired From Vehicle
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Baton Rouge, Louisiana — On April 20, 2025, at approximately 3:04 a.m., two Baton Rouge Police Officers responded to reports of an armed suspect at the Super 6 Inns and Suites at 9901 Gwenadele Ave. Officers located the suspect, identified as 34-year old Kevin Vallian, in the parking lot seated in a vehicle with the alarm going off. For several minutes Officers attempted to deescalate the situation through multiple verbal requests. Vallian, however, grabbed and fired an AR-style rifle during this interaction with law enforcement. In response, one Officer was able to return fire, fatally wounding Vallian. Officers were able to secure the AR rifle and a handgun from the suspect's person immediately before beginning life-saving measures, including CPR while awaiting EMS. No officers were injured during this incident. Both Officers involved in this incident were placed on administrative leave.
